title: Upcycled Products
subtitle: 「升級再造產品／再利用商品／由廢料製成的產品」，究竟是哪一種 upcycled products？
description: 「升級再造產品／再利用商品／由廢料製成的產品」，究竟是哪一種 upcycled products？

words.meaning: 再利用商品；改作他用的產品
words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義說法之一，表示把原有物品或材料改作新的用途；未必經過工業式回收處理。
words.example: The shop sells repurposed goods made from old furniture and fabric.
words.exampleZh: 這間店出售由舊家具和布料改造成的再利用商品。

exercises.original: The market sells upcycled products made from old doors and crates.
exercises.zh: 這個市場出售由舊門和木箱改造成的升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: repurposed goods · 再利用商品；改作他用的產品

options.explanation: second-hand goods = 二手商品未必經改造；這裡 old doors and crates 被製成新用途。
refurbished products = 翻新通常保留原本用途，不符合改作新用途。
repurposed goods = 舊門和木箱被改造成新商品，核心是 repurposed。
eco-friendly products = 太廣，沒有表達舊物改作新用途。
handmade products = 可能是手工，但未必使用舊材料。
waste products = 容易理解為廢棄物本身。

exercises.original: The shop specialises in upcycled products created from unwanted household items.
exercises.zh: 這間店專門出售由不再需要的家居物品改造成的升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: repurposed goods · 再利用商品；改作他用的產品

options.explanation: recycled products = 可能把材料分解重製；原句更突出直接改造舊物。
second-hand goods = 只是再次出售不夠。
refurbished products = 修復不是改作新用途。
repurposed goods = unwanted household items 被轉成新商品，最自然是 repurposed goods。
mass-produced goods = 與小規模改造概念不符。
new products = 忽略舊物來源。

exercises.original: Designers turned old suitcases into upcycled products for home storage.
exercises.zh: 設計師把舊行李箱改造成家居收納用的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: repurposed goods · 再利用商品；改作他用的產品

options.explanation: refurbished luggage = 如果仍作行李箱才是 refurbish；此處用途變成 storage。
second-hand suitcases = 未表達改造。
recycled plastic = 材料和處理方式都不對。
eco goods = 太泛。
repurposed goods = 行李箱改變用途成收納商品，repurposed goods 最精確。
waste items = 忽略轉化後已成商品。

words.note: 描述性很強，當 upcycled products 強調把原本會被丟棄的材料轉化成新產品時很自然。
words.example: The exhibition features products made from waste collected from local businesses.
words.exampleZh: 展覽展示由本地企業收集的廢料製成的產品。

exercises.original: The competition rewards upcycled products created from discarded packaging.
exercises.zh: 比賽獎勵由棄置包裝製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: products made from waste · 由廢料製成的產品

options.explanation: second-hand goods = 不是再次出售舊商品。
refurbished products = 不是修復原包裝。
eco-friendly products = 太廣，未指出廢料來源。
products made from waste = discarded packaging 明確表示產品由 waste 製成。
handmade products = 未必由廢料製成。
new packaging = 與原意相反。

exercises.original: Students designed upcycled products using bottle caps and scrap cardboard.
exercises.zh: 學生利用瓶蓋和廢紙板設計升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: products made from waste · 由廢料製成的產品

options.explanation: reused products = 可接近，但沒有明確表達成品由 waste materials 製成。
refurbished products = 不合原料型製作。
second-hand goods = 不合。
biodegradable products = 是否可生物降解與此無關。
products made from waste = 瓶蓋和廢紙板都是 waste materials，因此這個描述最直白。
factory waste = 這只是材料，不是完成品。

exercises.original: The museum shop features upcycled products made from exhibition banners.
exercises.zh: 博物館商店出售由舊展覽橫額製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: products made from waste · 由廢料製成的產品

options.explanation: souvenirs = 可能是紀念品，但未表達材料來源。
refurbished banners = 如果只是修復橫額就不是新產品。
second-hand goods = 不合。
eco-friendly products = 範圍太廣。
recycled paper products = 原料和加工方式都被不必要收窄。
products made from waste = 舊展覽橫額被作為廢料轉化成商品，products made from waste 很自然。

words.note: 和 upcycled products 幾乎同義，只是把 products 換成更日常的 goods；適合零售、設計和環保語境。
words.example: The market has a section devoted to upcycled goods.
words.exampleZh: 這個市場設有專區售賣升級再造商品。

exercises.original: The fair has a stall selling upcycled products made by local artists.
exercises.zh: 市集有一個攤位出售本地藝術家製作的升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: upcycled goods · 升級再造商品

options.explanation: second-hand goods = 不一定經藝術家改造。
refurbished products = 不一定有新用途。
waste products = 不是成品的自然名稱。
eco-friendly goods = 太廣。
upcycled goods = goods 是零售語境中對 products 的自然替換。
handmade goods = 只表示製作方式。

exercises.original: Consumers are becoming more interested in upcycled products for the home.
exercises.zh: 消費者愈來愈有興趣購買家居升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: upcycled goods · 升級再造商品

options.explanation: recycled materials = 這是材料而不是商品。
used goods = 未必改造。
refurbished goods = 主要是修復。
green products = 範圍太廣。
waste goods = 不自然。
upcycled goods = 零售消費語境中，upcycled goods 幾乎等同 upcycled products。

exercises.original: The online store groups its upcycled products by material.
exercises.zh: 網店按材料分類升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: upcycled goods · 升級再造商品

options.explanation: upcycled goods = 網店產品分類語境中，goods 很自然。
second-hand goods = 分類依據可能相同，但語意缺少轉化。
raw waste = 不是 store products。
refurbished items = 不完全同義。
eco products = 太廣。
handicrafts = 不一定用廢料。

words.meaning: 再生材料產品；由回收材料製成的產品
words.note: 當產品使用從舊建築、家具、工業廢料等取回的材料重新製作時可用；比一般 upcycled 更突出 reclaimed materials。
words.example: The studio creates reclaimed-material products from discarded timber.
words.exampleZh: 這間工作室利用棄置木材製作再生材料產品。

exercises.original: The furniture studio sells upcycled products made from timber recovered from old buildings.
exercises.zh: 家具工作室出售由舊建築回收木材製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: reclaimed-material products · 再生材料產品；由回收材料製成的產品

options.explanation: refurbished furniture = 如果是修復舊家具才用；此處是 recovered timber 製作新品。
second-hand furniture = 不合。
recycled plastic products = 材料不對。
eco-friendly furniture = 太廣。
waste timber = 只是原料。
reclaimed-material products = timber recovered from old buildings 是 reclaimed material 的典型來源。

exercises.original: The collection includes upcycled products made with salvaged metal.
exercises.zh: 這個系列包括用回收舊金屬製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: reclaimed-material products · 再生材料產品；由回收材料製成的產品

options.explanation: reclaimed-material products = salvaged metal 和 reclaimed-material products 搭配非常自然。
second-hand goods = 不是直接轉售。
refurbished products = 不是修復原物件。
new metal products = 忽略 salvaged。
biodegradable goods = 金屬不可這樣概括。
waste products = 未表達已轉化成商品。

exercises.original: The hotel chose upcycled products made from reclaimed wood for the lobby.
exercises.zh: 酒店為大堂選用了由回收木材製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: reclaimed-material products · 再生材料產品；由回收材料製成的產品

options.explanation: refurbished products = 不一定由 recovered raw material 製作。
reclaimed-material products = 當句子已明確指出 reclaimed wood，這個說法最精確。
used furniture = 沒有改造線索。
recycled paper goods = 材料不符。
eco products = 太泛。
new timber products = 忽略 reclaimed wood。

words.note: 強調透過設計和創意把舊物重新利用，而不是單純回收；很符合 upcycling 的核心概念。
words.example: The fair showcases creatively reused products made by local designers.
words.exampleZh: 市集展示由本地設計師製作的創意再利用產品。

exercises.original: The design festival celebrates upcycled products that give old objects a new purpose.
exercises.zh: 設計節慶表揚賦予舊物新用途的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: creatively reused products · 創意再利用產品

options.explanation: creatively reused products = give old objects a new purpose 正是 creative reuse。
second-hand goods = 沒有 new purpose。
refurbished products = 通常恢復原用途。
recycled materials = 只是材料層次。
eco-friendly goods = 缺少 creative reuse。
ordinary products = 相反。

exercises.original: Artists displayed upcycled products made by combining broken household items.
exercises.zh: 藝術家展示把破損家居物品重新組合而成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: creatively reused products · 創意再利用產品

options.explanation: refurbished products = 不是單純修復破損物品。
creatively reused products = 藝術家把破損物品重新組合，creatively reused 比一般 reused 更精確。
used goods = 未表達重新組合。
waste products = 忽略創意轉化。
mass-produced goods = 與 artists combining items 不符。
new products = 沒有舊物來源。

exercises.original: The workshop teaches participants how to make upcycled products from everyday objects.
exercises.zh: 工作坊教參加者如何把日常物品製成升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: creatively reused products · 創意再利用產品

options.explanation: second-hand goods = 不是再次出售。
refurbished products = 未必只是修復。
creatively reused products = 教人把 everyday objects 創意改造成新品，最符合 creatively reused products。
recycled-content goods = 可能經材料處理，和 everyday objects direct reuse 不同。
eco products = 太廣。
handmade products = 未必使用舊物。

words.note: 表示舊物或舊材料被拆解、改造後製成新的產品；比 recycled products 更能保留『由舊物重新設計』的感覺。
words.example: The brand sells remade products using fabric from unsold clothes.
words.exampleZh: 這個品牌利用滯銷衣物的布料製作重新製作的產品。

exercises.original: The fashion label sells upcycled products made from unsold clothing.
exercises.zh: 這個時裝品牌出售由滯銷衣物重新製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: remade products · 重新製作的產品

options.explanation: second-hand clothing = 不是直接轉售。
remade products = 滯銷衣物被重新剪裁或重製成新品，remade products 很自然。
refurbished clothing = 主要是修補恢復。
recycled fibres = 可能把纖維分解重造，處理方式不同。
new clothing = 忽略舊衣來源。
eco-friendly clothing = 太廣。

exercises.original: The company turns damaged bags into upcycled products with new designs.
exercises.zh: 公司把損壞袋子重新製成有新設計的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: remade products · 重新製作的產品

options.explanation: refurbished bags = 如果只是修復才用 refurbished；此處有 new designs。
used bags = 沒有重製。
remade products = new designs 表示舊品被重新製作，而非單純修復。
recycled plastic = 未必是塑膠，也未必分解材料。
waste bags = 不是完成品。
second-hand goods = 不合。

exercises.original: Several upcycled products in the collection use fabric from old uniforms.
exercises.zh: 系列中數款升級再造產品使用舊制服布料。
exercises.upgrade: remade products · 重新製作的產品

options.explanation: refurbished uniforms = 成品不再是原制服。
used uniforms = 不合。
recycled-content products = 可能合理，但 remade 更保留直接使用舊布的概念。
remade products = 利用舊制服布料重新製成產品，remade products 很精確。
new textiles = 忽略舊料。
waste uniforms = 不是商品。

words.meaning: 由回收舊料製成的商品
words.note: 當原料來自被救回、拆卸或避免棄置的木材、金屬、玻璃等時很合適；常見於家具和室內設計。
words.example: The workshop produces salvaged-material goods from old building components.
words.exampleZh: 這間工作坊利用舊建築構件製作回收舊料商品。

exercises.original: The shop sells upcycled products made from wood rescued from demolition sites.
exercises.zh: 商店出售由拆卸工地救回木材製成的升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: salvaged-material goods · 由回收舊料製成的商品

options.explanation: new timber goods = 和 rescued wood 相反。
refurbished furniture = 不一定用 demolition timber。
salvaged-material goods = wood rescued from demolition sites 正是 salvaged material。
second-hand goods = 不是直接轉售。
recycled paper = 材料不符。
eco goods = 太廣。

exercises.original: Designers used old metal signs to create upcycled products.
exercises.zh: 設計師利用舊金屬標誌製作升級再造商品。
exercises.upgrade: salvaged-material goods · 由回收舊料製成的商品

options.explanation: refurbished signs = 如果仍作標誌才對；原句是創作新商品。
second-hand signs = 沒有轉化。
new metalware = 忽略舊料。
salvaged-material goods = 舊金屬標誌被保留下來作新材料，屬 salvaged-material use。
waste products = 過度負面且不自然。
recycled plastic goods = 材料錯誤。

exercises.original: The café is furnished with upcycled products made from recovered industrial parts.
exercises.zh: 咖啡店使用由回收工業零件製成的升級再造商品作家具。
exercises.upgrade: salvaged-material goods · 由回收舊料製成的商品

options.explanation: second-hand furniture = 可能未經改造。
refurbished machinery = 原件用途不再是 machinery。
new furniture = 忽略 recovered parts。
eco-friendly furniture = 太廣。
salvaged-material goods = recovered industrial parts 明確指 salvaged materials。
waste equipment = 不是成品。

words.meaning: 由廢料轉化而成的產品
words.note: 較正式、描述性，強調 waste 被轉化成具有新用途和較高價值的產品。
words.example: The programme supports transformed waste products created by social enterprises.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃支援由社會企業製作的廢料轉化產品。

exercises.original: The project supports upcycled products that turn waste into useful household items.
exercises.zh: 這個項目支援把廢料轉化成實用家居用品的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: transformed waste products · 由廢料轉化而成的產品

options.explanation: waste products = 可能只是廢棄物本身，沒有轉化意味。
second-hand goods = 不是直接再售。
refurbished goods = 不一定使用 waste。
transformed waste products = turn waste into useful household items 直接支持 transformed waste products。
eco products = 太廣。
raw materials = 不是完成品。

exercises.original: The exhibition focuses on upcycled products created from materials that would otherwise be discarded.
exercises.zh: 展覽聚焦於由原本會被棄置材料製成的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: transformed waste products · 由廢料轉化而成的產品

options.explanation: used goods = 沒有轉化。
refurbished goods = 未必從 discarded materials 製作。
recycled raw material = 不是完成品。
new products = 忽略 waste origin。
transformed waste products = 材料本會被丟棄，但被轉化成新產品，這個正式說法很準確。
handmade goods = 只描述製作方式。

exercises.original: Social enterprises are developing upcycled products from local waste streams.
exercises.zh: 社會企業正利用本地廢物流開發升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: transformed waste products · 由廢料轉化而成的產品

options.explanation: second-hand goods = 不合 waste streams。
refurbished products = 不是修復既有成品。
eco-friendly products = 太泛。
raw waste = 不是 developed products。
reused packaging only = 範圍過窄。
transformed waste products = local waste streams + product development 很適合較正式的 transformed waste products。

words.note: 當 upcycled products 仍可看出原本物件，但經過重新設計成新用途時很自然；更突出 redesign。
words.example: The display includes redesigned discarded items such as lamps made from old bottles.
words.exampleZh: 展品包括重新設計的棄置物品，例如由舊瓶製成的燈。

exercises.original: The exhibition includes upcycled products such as lamps made from old bottles.
exercises.zh: 展覽包括升級再造產品，例如由舊瓶製成的燈。
exercises.upgrade: redesigned discarded items · 重新設計的棄置物品

options.explanation: second-hand bottles = 瓶子不是直接再售。
refurbished lamps = 原本並不是燈。
recycled glass only = 未必把玻璃熔解回收。
waste items = 忽略 redesign。
redesigned discarded items = 舊瓶被重新設計成燈，最符合 redesigned discarded items。
new household goods = 沒有舊物來源。

exercises.original: Students created upcycled products from broken umbrellas.
exercises.zh: 學生利用破雨傘製作重新設計的棄置物品。
exercises.upgrade: redesigned discarded items · 重新設計的棄置物品

options.explanation: refurbished umbrellas = 如果修回雨傘才用；此處是新產品。
used umbrellas = 沒有 redesign。
recycled plastic = 處理方式被不必要限定。
eco goods = 太廣。
waste umbrellas = 只是原料狀態。
redesigned discarded items = broken umbrellas 被創作成新物件，redesigned discarded items 很準確。

exercises.original: The store displays upcycled products that still reveal what the original objects were.
exercises.zh: 商店展示仍可看出原物件模樣的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: redesigned discarded items · 重新設計的棄置物品

options.explanation: redesigned discarded items = 仍可辨認原物件、但已重新設計成新品，是 upcycling 的典型特徵。
recycled-content goods = 若材料被分解重製，通常較難看出原物件。
refurbished goods = 用途可能沒變。
second-hand goods = 沒有重新設計。
new products = 與 original objects 線索不符。
raw waste = 不是 finished goods。

words.note: 較正式，強調原材料或廢物經轉化後價值、功能或美感提升；可用於政策、商業和循環經濟語境。
words.example: The project encourages value-added recycled products rather than simple material recovery.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目鼓勵增值再造產品，而不只是簡單回收材料。

exercises.original: The policy encourages upcycled products that increase the value of discarded materials.
exercises.zh: 政策鼓勵提升棄置材料價值的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: value-added recycled products · 增值再造產品

options.explanation: basic recycling = 只表示材料回收，未必增加價值。
second-hand goods = 沒有轉化增值。
refurbished products = 可能恢復價值，但未必由 discarded materials 重新設計。
eco-friendly products = 太廣。
waste products = 相反，未強調增值。
value-added recycled products = increase the value of discarded materials 正是 value-added 的核心。

exercises.original: The circular-economy programme funds upcycled products with higher-value new uses.
exercises.zh: 循環經濟計劃資助具有更高價值新用途的升級再造產品。
exercises.upgrade: value-added recycled products · 增值再造產品

options.explanation: value-added recycled products = 政策／循環經濟語境中，強調 higher-value use 可用 value-added recycled products。
raw recycling = 不表示 higher-value use。
second-hand sales = 沒有重新設計。
refurbishment = 通常恢復原功能，不一定新用途。
green products = 過度寬泛。
waste disposal = 方向相反。

exercises.original: Businesses are developing upcycled products instead of simply recovering raw material.
exercises.zh: 企業正開發升級再造產品，而不是只回收原材料。
exercises.upgrade: value-added recycled products · 增值再造產品

options.explanation: basic recycled material = 和 instead of simply recovering raw material 對比不符。
value-added recycled products = 原句明確對比單純 material recovery 和增值產品，因此此說法最貼切。
second-hand goods = 不合。
refurbished items = 不一定涉及 raw material value chain。
eco products = 太泛。
waste outputs = 不是新商品。

falseSynonyms.zh: 回收產品不一定等於升級再造 recycled products 通常指材料經處理後重新製成產品；upcycled products 更強調保留或重新利用舊物，並提升其價值或功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Recycling often breaks materials down; upcycling usually gives them a higher-value new use.

falseSynonyms.zh: 二手商品不等於升級再造商品 second-hand goods 只是再次出售或使用，通常沒有經過重新設計或改造。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A second-hand item is reused as it is; an upcycled item is transformed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 翻新產品不等於升級再造 refurbished products 通常被修復至可再次使用，主要功能通常不變；upcycling 往往改變用途或價值。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Refurbishing restores an item; upcycling transforms it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 重用不一定等於升級再造 reused 只表示再次使用；若沒有改造、重新設計或增值，就未必是 upcycled。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All upcycling involves reuse, but not all reuse is upcycling.

falseSynonyms.zh: 廢料產品可能只是廢棄物 waste products 可以指生產過程產生的廢棄物，而不是由廢料製成的新商品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Waste products may be discarded materials, not products created from waste.

falseSynonyms.zh: 環保產品範圍更廣 eco-friendly products 可以節能、可重用、低碳或可生物降解，不一定使用舊物或廢料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An eco-friendly product is not necessarily upcycled.

falseSynonyms.zh: 手工製品不一定是升級再造 handmade 只描述製作方式；原料可以是全新材料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A handmade product may be made entirely from new materials.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩種處理方式不同 upcycled 通常保留材料或物件並提升其價值；recycled 常把材料分解後重新加工。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Upcycling adds value through reuse; recycling commonly reprocesses material.
